item.title: Canon Announces Multi-Camera Orchestration (MCO) to Simplify Multi-Camera PTZ Production
item.description: Canon has announced Multi-Camera Orchestration, a new system designed to let a single operator run a professional multi-camera production using its PTZ cameras.

item.title: Final Cut Pro 12 launches with AI search tools and deeper Creator Studio ties
item.description: Final Cut Pro 12 is one of the central planks in Apple's new Creator Studio subscription offering, but its major version status seems more about integration with that than any radical new features.

item.title: Inside the Edit: How David Barker Edited 'Chasing Summer'
item.description: Chasing Summer has been one of the most talked-about movies at Sundance this year. We went inside the edit with the film's editor David Barker.

item.title: The Three Data Backup Mistakes That Still Kill Productions
item.description: Replay: Backing up footage isn’t just about making copies. It’s about making the right copies, in the right places, every time. Because the real horror story isn’t a drive failure — it’s discovering too late that you’ve carefully archived the wrong card, the wrong folder, or nothing at all.

item.title: Godox AD800Pro — 800 W Battery Flash for Pros
item.description: The AD800Pro All-in-One Outdoor Flash is Godox's most powerful monolight strobe unit yet.

item.title: Benro NE1 Electronic Variable ND Filter Kit Now Live on Indiegogo
item.description: The Benro NE1 Electronic Variable ND Filter Kit got rather a lot of attention when it was first unveiled last year, and it goes live on Indiegogo tomorrow for an early bird price of $228.

item.title: Blazar Announces Talon 1.5X Full-Frame Autofocus Anamorphic Lens Series
item.description: Blazar’s Talon 1.5X AF anamorphic lens series is the first autofocus-equipped 1.5× anamorphic optics designed for full-frame mirrorless systems.

item.title: Adobe Offers Unlimited Generations for Adobe Firefly AI Until March 16
item.description: Adobe has announced that Firefly subscribers can create unlimited generations with its various AI image models, though the unlimited offer is only available for a limited time.

item.title: NANLITE FC-720B & FC-720C – 750W Bi-Color and Full-Color LED Spotlights with High Output and Advanced Control
item.description: NANLITE’s new 750W bi-color FC-720B and full-color FC-720C are high-output LED spotlights aimed at creators and videographers who need strong illuminance and consistent light quality.

item.title: Why the Death of 8K TV is Accelerating as LG Exits and Samsung Stands Alone
item.description: Last week, LG quietly withdrew from the 8K TV market, leaving Samsung the only major manufacturer still making 8K televisions. As far as the consumer goes, for all intents and purposes 8K is not resting, it's stone dead.
